mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hand syringe to the claw was most worthwhile: it brought the separate assemblies together into the finished mechanism.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the two cups was somewhat repetitive, although the separate results showed how they support opposite ends of the barrel.

surprise.text: I expected the plunger clip to fit the syringe, but the compatibility feedback showed that it fits the claw's bracket instead.

arbitrary.text: The first goal's instruction to slide a cup to the farther seat did not make its connection to the syringe clear until inspection.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue if another chapter showed the mechanism working; the construction was clear overall, but the text alone leaves its motion to the imagination.
